                 function connection.Redirect(arg1, kind)
                     if table.find({ "Dashboard", "Commands", "Manager" }, kind) then
                         shared["Nexus Dynamics"].Ribbon:ChangeTab(kind or "Dashboard")
                     elseif kind == "AuditLog" then
                         shared["Nexus Dynamics"].Ribbon:ChangeTab("AuditLog")
                     else
                         if kind == "Console" then
                             local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")
                             StarterGui:SetCore("DevConsoleVisible", not game.StarterGui:GetCore("DevConsoleVisible"))
                             arg1:Close(true)
                             return
                         end
                         if kind == "Settings" then
                             shared["Nexus Dynamics"].Ribbon:ChangeTab("Settings")
                         elseif kind == "CommandBar" then
                             shared["Nexus Dynamics"].Popups.CommandPrompt:Open()
                             arg1:Close(true)
                             return
                         end
                     end
                     arg1:Close()
                     shared["Nexus Dynamics"]:Open()
                 end

    function createPopup(arg1)
        local values1 = { Template = nil, Popup = nil, Message = nil, Timer = nil, SetTimer = nil, SetContent = nil, Show = nil, Hide = nil }
        function values1.SetTimer(arg1, arg2)
            arg1.__timer = arg2 or 20
            coroutine.wrap(function()
                while arg1.__timer > 0 do
                    arg1.Timer.Text = tostring(arg1.__timer)
                    arg1.__timer = arg1.__timer - 1
                    task.wait(1)
                end
                arg1:Hide()
                task.wait(0.25)
                arg1.Template:Destroy()
            end)()
            return arg1
        end
        function values1.SetContent(gui, text)
            gui.Message.Text = text
            return gui
        end
        function values1.Show(arg1)
            arg1.Popup.Element:TweenPosition(UDim2.fromScale(0, 0), "Out", "Back", 0.25)

        end

    function createFlyPopup(Speed2, Collision2)

                arg1.Disconnect:Disconnect()
            end
            arg1.Disconnect = game:GetService("UserInputService").InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessedEvent)
                if gameProcessedEvent then
                    return
                end
                if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F and arg1.Template and arg1.Template.Parent then
                    arg1:SetState(not arg1.State)
                    arg1.State = not arg1.State
                    local values4 = {
                        request = true,
                        player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer,
                        message = (if not shared["Nexus Dynamics"].FlyCollision then (if not shared["Nexus Dynamics"].FlyState then ("%* me %*"):format("clip", shared["Nexus Dynamics"].FlySpeed) else ("%* me %*"):format("noclip", shared["Nexus Dynamics"].FlySpeed)) else (if not shared["Nexus Dynamics"].FlyState then (("%* me %*"):format("unfly", shared["Nexus Dynamics"].FlySpeed) or (if not shared["Nexus Dynamics"].FlyState then ("%* me %*"):format("clip", shared["Nexus Dynamics"].FlySpeed) else ("%* me %*"):format("noclip", shared["Nexus Dynamics"].FlySpeed))) else (("%* me %*"):format("fly", shared["Nexus Dynamics"].FlySpeed) or (if not shared["Nexus Dynamics"].FlyState then ("%* me %*"):format("clip", shared["Nexus Dynamics"].FlySpeed) else ("%* me %*"):format("noclip", shared["Nexus Dynamics"].FlySpeed))))),
                    }
                    shared["Nexus Dynamics"].Signals["<command>"]:InvokeServer(values4)
                end
            end)
            return arg1
        end
        function values2.Hide(arg1)
            arg1.Popup.Element:TweenPosition(UDim2.fromScale(1.5, 0), "Out", "Back", 0.25)

        end

    Libraries.Notification:Connect(function(data)
        local function WriteEffect(arg1, arg2)
            local value1 = tostring(arg2)
            local value2 = coroutine.wrap(function()
                for i = 1, #value1 do
                    arg1.Text = value1:sub(1, i)
                    task.wait(0.01)
                end
            end)
            value2()
            local values3 = {}
            function values3.Stop()
                coroutine.close(value2)
            end
            return values3
        end
        if data["type"] == "hint" then
            Hint.Text = ""
            Hint.Visible = true

                if Hint.Text ~= data.message then
                    return
                end
                Hint.Visible = false
            end)
        end
        if data["type"] == "message" then
            Message.From.Text = (data and data.speaker and "Message from " .. data.speaker.Name or "")

                if not (Message.Message.Text == (data and data.message or "")) then
                    return
                end

            end)

                    break
                end
            until tonumber(value25.Timer.Text) < 1

    Libraries.Notification:Connect(function(data)
        local function WriteEffect(arg1, arg2)
            local value1 = tostring(arg2)
            local value2 = coroutine.wrap(function()
                for i = 1, #value1 do
                    arg1.Text = value1:sub(1, i)
                    task.wait(0.01)
                end
            end)
            value2()
            local values3 = {}
            function values3.Stop()
                coroutine.close(value2)
            end
            return values3
        end
        if data["type"] == "hint" then
            Hint.Text = ""
            Hint.Visible = true
            WriteEffect(Hint, data.message)
            task.delay(data.timer or 20, function()
                if Hint.Text ~= data.message then
                    return
                end
                Hint.Visible = false
            end)
        end
        if data["type"] == "message" then
            Message.From.Text = (data and data.speaker and "Message from " .. data.speaker.Name or "")
            Message.Visible = true
            WriteEffect(Message.Message, (data and data.message or ""))
            task.delay((data.timer or 20), function()
                if not (Message.Message.Text == (data and data.message or "")) then
                    return
                end
                Message.Visible = false
            end)
        end
        if data["type"] == "countdown" then
            local value25 = createPopup():SetContent(data.message):SetTimer(data.timer):Show()
            repeat
                local timer = value25.Timer
                timer = timer.Text
